name: Minimalism
what_it_means: Minimalism strips an interface down to what matters: one idea per screen, generous whitespace, a restrained palette and quiet typography. Every element must earn its place, so hierarchy comes from spacing and scale rather than decoration.
signature_moves: Huge whitespace, few elements per view
Thin type, small caps nav, quiet borders
A single hero object or line of copy
best_for: Premium products, portfolios, studios, single-product launches
prompt_template: B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ] ** Design a landing page for [PRODUCT] in a strict Minimalist style. Off-white background (#FAFAF8), near-black text (#111). One centered hero: a single product image on a soft shadow, a 2-line headline in a light 56px sans-serif with tight tracking, one quiet text link as the CTA. Navigation: 3 small links, 12px, letter spaced. At least 120px vertical padding between sections, max 3 elements per section, no cards, no gradients, no icons. Use one warm accent (#C9A27E) only for hover states. Hierarchy comes from size and spacing only.
